notes: The only change is that I removed `localparam Derived`. The body had declared it after the header had already used it, which caused the USEBEFOREDECL errors. The header has to supply LPARA_STRB_W, LPARA_REQ_W and LPARA_RESP_W itself, so the body no longer defines `Derived`. If the real header still contains the literal `Derived`, it has to be replaced with real values before compiling, because the body can't fix that.
